title: Malicious code in ppbbll5 (npm)
description: The npm package ppbbll5 is a stub package that exports no real functionality but includes a postinstall script and runtime code that sends system information to a suspicious external server. It collects data such as package name, hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node.js version, and sends this information via HTTPS to a hardcoded endpoint with TLS verification disabled. This behavior occurs automatically on installation and module import without user consent or documentation.
